notes: Printed names without suffix (RAVINE, WARNER, FLORA, VICTOR, GUY, COON, FOX, RENNER, EMMING, CONROY, SOHN, VERNON) are written with 'Street'; KLOTTER AV. is 'Klotter Avenue'. Alleys are printed ALLEY No 1 ... ALLEY No 4 and written 'Alley No. 1' etc. The street at x~3330-3580 is printed SOHN (not John). Warner is 60' here; Ravine, Flora, Victor and Guy all cross it and continue north onto 250/251. Ravine leans slightly (centre ~1102 at Warner, ~1158 at Klotter). Coon (25'6") runs from an open north end to the Alley No. 1/No. 2 line; Alley No. 1 (6', from Ravine) and Alley No. 2 (~7', east to Renner's 25' strip) form one east-west line at Coon's foot, and Alley No. 3 (5') continues Coon's line south (centre ~20 px east of Coon's) to a dead end, so three T points 2-20 px apart there. Fox (25') runs Coon to Flora (T both ends). Victor and Guy end at Emming (Emming's south line continuous); Vernon (40') starts at Emming. Emming here is the 'Emming Street' of sheet 238 (east of Ravine), not the 'Emming' that ends at Quarry on 238. Renner (40') crosses Emming and Conroy and continues south onto 228. Sohn and Vernon both jog at Conroy: Sohn north part centre x~3385, south part (onto 228) x~3516; Vernon north part (40') x~5192, south part (~20', labelled VERNON, onto 228) x~4790; each recorded as two T points on Conroy with the same name. Conroy (40') continues east past x~5610 onto 230; Emming continues east past Guy onto 240. Klotter is only on the west side of Ravine at the bottom-left corner (T). Retaining-wall lines inside the blocks and the platform in block 2 are not streets.
